blocks.title: System testing
blocks.text: System testing is a higher level of testing in which the entire software system is tested as a whole. Testers evaluate its overall functionality, performance, security and compliance with the specified requirements.

It is done in an environment that closely resembles the real (production) environment, so the software is checked under real-world conditions. It finds defects that come from the interaction of the various parts and confirms that the software meets its intended purpose.
